text: There is only a remote chance the conflict will have a direct impact on Russia’s ability to conduct the war in Ukraine Since 2024, Russia’s dependence on Iranian uncrewed aerial systems has almost certainly declined as Russia has expanded its own domestic production Whilst the conflict continues, Russian government oil revenues will almost certainly increase in response to the rising global prices and reduced discounts on Russian oil, as buyers have access to fewer alternative suppliers This will almost certainly provide Russia a short-term boost and greater capacity to fund the war in Ukraine
